deficits.suggestion: Add a pedestrian refuge island at the marked crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait on the wide road.
Install dropped kerbs at the marked crossing to improve accessibility for pedestrians with mobility aids.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.

ratings.reason: The road is wide and lacks a central refuge island at the crossing.
The kerbs at the crossing appear to be at full height without ramps.
Street lighting poles are clearly visible along the road.
